verdict.rationale: Orb's own 'essential dunning' documentation shows automatic payment retries on a fixed 1, 4 and 9 day schedule, so there is a first-party dunning capability. Nothing shows a configurable sequence or the other elements of the story. The grace periods in the invoice-issuance docs govern when invoices are issued, not payment-failure handling, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: configurable dunning sequence timing, branded dunning emails, in-app banners, dunning grace periods, final-state rules (cancel vs unpaid), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can configure automated dunning sequences — branded emails, in-app banners, grace periods, and final-state rules like cancel vs unpaid

citations.quote: If payment attempts is enabled and the initial attempt fails, Orb will automatically retry the charge after 1, 4, and 9 days from the initial payment attempt.
